channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Timberland Does Woven Bottega Boots as Beautiful as Bottega
item.description: Timberland's well-woven leather boot is basically a full-on Bottega Veneta boot. It's not an official collab but this is one work shoe that screams Bottega.

item.title: The Sundance Uniform: What Filmmakers Actually Wear
item.description: Park City style is shaped by climate and comfort. The result is a uniform that’s cozy first, and stylish second.

item.title: These Nike Air Max Traded Their Tech-y Tactility For Sumptuous Suede
item.description: Having been the subject of loud collaborations with Patta, Palace, and Vaquera, the Nike DN8 Black Suede is a quiet new angle.

item.title: We Got Inside: PUMA's Suede House
item.description: PUMA takes over Paris Fashion Week with Suede House, spotlighting the iconic Suede sneaker through culture, collaborations, and cutting-edge design.

item.title: These Stealth Wealth-y Superstars Are Soft Like Butter
item.description: The Superstar Vintage Core Black/Gold Metallic is still a classic but the new full-grain leather brings a new element into the mix.

item.title: Finally, Long-Forgotten Vivienne Westwood Runway Shows Are Seeing the Light of Day
item.description: Rare footage of Vivienne Westwood & Malcolm McLaren's early-'80s Worlds End runway shows recently resurfaced & quietly arrives in an arthouse movie theater.

item.title: L.A. Shows Up for KOI x Oatly Barista Workwear Launch
item.description: Last week Kids of Immigrants and Oatly debuted their limited edition “Pour Into Others” capsule collection in the heart of Los Angeles. Between creative linkups and oat milk-infused pours, the capsule and community came to life. Hit the link in bio to see how it all went down.

item.title: The First-Ever Clarks Clothing Is Really Just Clarks Merch
item.description: Clarks' excellent Fall/Winter 2026 Originals collection, overseen by artist Blanche Yu, is accompanied by the first-ever Clarks clothing collection.

item.title: During This Coldest of Months, These Nikes Radiate With the Warmest of Sunrays
item.description: Decked in the hues of a picture-perfect sunrise, the Nike Air Max Muse Sunset is brimming with summertime appeal and is slated for a release in June 2026.
